the CHHC NMR experiment can be used to extract the (1)JH,H) magnetization exchange function, and that this experiment is a sensitive probe for the detection of intermolecular (1)H-H distances.

The main takeaway from our work is that

CHHC NMR can provide quantitative insight into (1)H dipolar couplings, and thus H-H distances, in a manner that is not subject to the same experimental artifacts that can affect the analysis of (13)C-(13)C dipolar couplings in (13)C-CHHC NMR.
the CHHC buildup curves can be used to obtain information on the (1) H-(1)H dipolar couplings in a system, provided the effect of non-selective cross-polarization is properly corrected for.
